feedback: some of the  trees seem to be floating in the background, can you maybe make sure the trees are spawned correctly, and the game is too easy, I think my sword swing is too fast and spammable, can you fix both of these issues?

selection.reason: addTree to fix the Y position of trees so they don't float. update to implement a cooldown or slower animation for the sword swing. resetGame to initialize the new sword cooldown state variables.

patch.notes: Added a global background floor plane to prevent decorative trees from floating outside of bounds, and slowed down the sword attack animation while implementing an attack cooldown to prevent spamming.
